metadata.description: Alpha distribution channel for Magus — experimental plugins with partial wiring, TODO-gaps, and evolving interfaces. Source of truth: MadAppGang/magus-src. This is a lean dist repo.

plugins.name: claudoom
plugins.description: Plays Doom-engine WADs in a Claude Code pane: runs doom-cli (GPLv2, built from upstream) in a private tmux server and repaints its frames into a Raster. Fetches Freedoom (BSD) on demand. DOOM is a ZeniMax trademark; not affiliated with id Software, ZeniMax or Anthropic.

releases.summary: /claudoom plays a Doom-engine WAD in a pane beside the conversation, at about 30 frames a second

plugins.name: agent-colours
plugins.description: Colours subagent and skill names in Claude Code by their own color: field. An agent's name sits on a coloured badge in its Agent row and in replies; a skill's name is drawn in its colour in its Skill row and in replies. Alpha: a function-hooks mod; it ships no commands or skills of its own.

releases.summary: A skill's name is drawn in the colour of its own color: field, in its Skill row and in replies
Each subagent's name sits on a coloured badge, in its Agent row and in every reply that names it
